Amounts, balances and TWAB live as\n///         encrypted euint64 handles \u2014 only the owner of a balance can decrypt it.\n/// @dev    Non-upgradeable by design. There is intentionally NO function that\n///         moves user principal other than the deposit callback and the two\n///         withdraw functions \u2014 \"no admin sweep\" holds by construction.\n///\n///         Deposit flow (decided Day 1, see COMPATIBILITY_NOTES \u00a73):\n///         user calls token.confidentialTransferAndCall(pot, \u2026) \u2192 token moves the\n///         ACTUAL transferred amount (token-side clamp: insufficient wallet balance\n///         becomes encrypted zero, never a revert) \u2192 token invokes\n///         onConfidentialTransferReceived on this contract with that actual amount\n///         \u2192 we return an encrypted verdict; `false` makes the token refund the\n///         whole transfer atomically (all-or-nothing, no plaintext leak).\ncontract PayDayPot is IERC7984Receiver, ZamaEthereumConfig, Ownable2Step, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard {\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Types\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    enum EpochPhase {\n        Open, // deposits + withdrawals + TWAB accrual\n        Snapshotting, // Day 3-4: freezing weights batch-by-batch\n        Drawing, // Day 4: randomness + winner selection\n        Settled // Day 5: prize claimable\n    }\n\n    struct Account {\n        euint64 principal; // encrypted current deposit balance\n        euint64 twabArea; // encrypted \u03a3 principal\u00b7dt, accrued in _checkpoint (Day 3)\n        uint64 lastCheckpoint; // plaintext timestamp of last accrual, clamped to epoch end\n        euint64 pendingPrize; // encrypted winnings, credited in selectBatch (claim: Day 5)\n        ebool won; // encrypted winner flag \u2014 contract-only ACL, never user-readable (\u00a715.1)\n        bool registered;\n    }\n\n    struct Epoch {\n        uint64 start;\n        uint64 end;\n        EpochPhase phase;\n        // Day 5 (claim/settle) is the last consumer; the ABI freezes then.\n        euint64 totalWeight; // \u03a3 frozen twabArea over all participants\n        euint64 random; // drawn exactly once per epoch, never rerolled\n        euint64 ticket; // winning ticket = \u230arandom\u00b7totalWeight/2^64\u230b (P-2), fixed with random\n        euint64 cumulative; // running weight sum carried across selectBatch txs\n        ebool selectedAny; // encrypted \"the winner has been crossed\" latch\n        uint32 snapshotCursor; // snapshot batch continuation cursor (permissionless)\n        uint32 selectCursor; // selection batch cursor \u2014 deliberately separate (\u00a76.5)\n        uint32 frozenCount; // participants at beginSnapshot \u2014 the denominator both cursors run against\n        bool drawn;\n        uint64 prizeAmount; // public sponsored prize (P-4), IMMUTABLE once drawn\n        euint64 prizeCipher; // prizeAmount + carried-over prize, frozen at requestRandom\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Immutable configuration\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// @notice The confidential ERC-7984 token this pool accepts.\n    IERC7984 public immutable TOKEN;\n    /// @notice The public ERC-20 backing TOKEN. Employer funding arrives in\n    ///         THIS asset and is wrapped inside fundPrize (decision (i)).\n    IERC20 public immutable UNDERLYING;\n    /// @notice Underlying units per confidential unit (1 for 6-decimals USDC).\n    uint256 public immutable RATE;\n    /// @notice Sponsor address funding the prize (no ACL over any user data).\n    address public immutable EMPLOYER;\n    /// @notice Epoch length in seconds (\u2264 30 days, enforced by P-3 budget).\n    uint64 public immutable EPOCH_DURATION;\n    /// @notice Max principal per user (encrypted cap-check on every deposit).\n    uint64 public immutable PER_USER_CAP;\n    /// @notice Max participants per pool (\u2264 32; keeps snapshot batches bounded).\n    uint32 public immutable PARTICIPANT_CAP;\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // State\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    uint256 public currentEpochId;\n    mapping(uint256 epochId => Epoch) private _epochs;\n    mapping(address user => Account) private _accounts;\n    address[] private _participants;\n\n    /// @dev Contract-only ACL \u2014 never allowed to any user, employer or owner,\n    ///      never made publicly decryptable. Inspected in tests via the\n    ///      mock-only debugger, and provable indirectly through conservation.\n    euint64 private _totalPrincipal;\n\n    /// @dev Prize carried over from epochs that ended with no winner (every\n    ///      participant's frozen weight was zero, so the ticket scan never\n    ///      crossed). Contract-only ACL, never\n    ///      publicly decryptable (#6).\n    ///\n    ///      Handle hygiene: this is only ever assigned the output of an FHE op\n    ///      (add/select), never a bare FHE.asEuint64(0). Trivial encryptions\n    ///      alias to one well-known handle (quirk #10), so assigning one in a\n    ///      winner-dependent branch would leak winner-existence by handle\n    ///      comparison alone \u2014 precisely what the encryption is hiding.\n    euint64 private _prizeCarry;\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Events \u2014 action/user/epoch only. NEVER an amount, encrypted or not.\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    event EpochStarted(uint256 indexed epochId, uint64 start, uint64 end);\n    /// @dev Snapshot events carry only public counters (participant slots,\n    ///      cursor position) \u2014 weights stay encrypted end-to-end.\n    event SnapshotStarted(uint256 indexed epochId, uint32 participantCount);\n    event SnapshotProgress(uint256 indexed epochId, uint32 cursor);\n    event SnapshotCompleted(uint256 indexed epochId);\n    event Registered(address indexed user, uint256 indexed epochId);\n    /// @dev Emitted on every deposit ATTEMPT \u2014 the encrypted cap verdict cannot\n    ///      be branched on, so a refunded (over-cap) deposit also emits this.\n    event Deposited(address indexed user, uint256 indexed epochId);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed user, uint256 indexed epochId);\n    /// @dev Draw events carry only public counters \u2014 never the randomness, the\n    ///      ticket, an amount, or (crucially) the winner's address.\n    event RandomRequested(uint256 indexed epochId);\n    event SelectProgress(uint256 indexed epochId, uint32 cursor);\n    event DrawCompleted(uint256 indexed epochId);\n    /// @dev The prize amount is public by design (P-4) but is read through the\n    ///      prizeAmountOf view, never carried in a log \u2014 one uniform event rule\n    ///      for the whole contract beats a per-event judgement call.\n    event PrizeFunded(uint256 indexed epochId);\n    event PrizeDefunded(uint256 indexed epochId);\n    /// @dev Emitted on every claim ATTEMPT, winner or not \u2014 the encrypted\n    ///      winnings cannot be branched on, and a log that appeared only for\n    ///      winners would name them outright (\u00a715.1, rule #5).\n    event PrizeClaimed(address indexed user, uint256 indexed epochId);\n    /// @dev The epoch is resolved and its prize is final. Emitted for BOTH\n    ///      terminal paths (scan complete, and the empty-pool fast path), so a\n    ///      UI has one signal to watch and cannot tell them apart by log shape.\n    event EpochSettled(uint256 indexed epochId);\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Errors \u2014 no amount parameters, plaintext-safe conditions only.\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    error NotToken(address caller);\n    error NotEmployer(address caller);\n    error PoolFull();\n    error NotRegistered(address user);\n    error WrongPhase();\n    error InvalidConfig();\n    error InvalidAmount();\n    error ZeroAddress();\n    error AlreadyDrawn();\n    error NotDrawn();\n    error SelectionComplete();\n    /// @dev Only ever raised on a PUBLIC fact: the caller has never been\n    ///      scanned by any draw, so no winnings handle exists yet. It never appears on a function\n    ///      that reads or moves user principal, TWAB or winnings (#3, #4).\n    modifier onlyEmployer() {\n        if (msg.sender != EMPLOYER) revert NotEmployer(msg.sender);\n        _;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Constructor\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    constructor(\n        IERC7984 token_,\n        address employer_,\n        uint64 epochDuration_,\n        uint64 perUserCap_,\n        uint32 participantCap_\n    ) Ownable(msg.sender) {\n        if (address(token_) == address(0) || employer_ == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        if (epochDuration_ == 0 || epochDuration_ > 30 days) revert InvalidConfig();\n        if (perUserCap_ == 0) revert InvalidConfig();\n        if (participantCap_ == 0 || participantCap_ > 32) revert InvalidConfig();\n        // P-3 overflow budget: worst-case \u03a3 twabArea = cap\u00b7users\u00b7duration must\n        // stay below 2^64 because FHE arithmetic wraps instead of reverting.\n        if (uint256(participantCap_) * uint256(perUserCap_) * uint256(epochDuration_) >= type(uint64).max) {\n            revert InvalidConfig();\n        }\n\n        // Read the wrapper shape once. This binds the pool to a wrapper-backed\n        // ERC-7984 (a bare ERC7984 has no underlying()/rate() and reverts here,\n        // at deploy time \u2014 the loudest possible place). Both are plain view\n        // calls, so quirk #13 (no FHE ops in a constructor) is respected.\n        IERC7984ERC20Wrapper wrapper = IERC7984ERC20Wrapper(address(token_));\n        address underlying_ = wrapper.underlying();\n        uint256 rate_ = wrapper.rate();\n        if (underlying_ == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();\n        // rate_ == 0 would let fundPrize credit prizeAmount while wrapping zero\n        // tokens \u2014 an unbacked prize, i.e. a hole straight through solvency.\n        if (rate_ == 0) revert InvalidConfig();\n\n        TOKEN = token_;\n        UNDERLYING = IERC20(underlying_);\n        RATE = rate_;\n        EMPLOYER = employer_;\n        EPOCH_DURATION = epochDuration_;\n        PER_USER_CAP = perUserCap_;\n        PARTICIPANT_CAP = participantCap_;\n\n        // No FHE ops in the constructor: they revert under plain `hardhat deploy`\n        // (mock coprocessor only initializes inside the test runner, quirk #6).\n        // _totalPrincipal is lazily zero-initialized on first use instead.\n        currentEpochId = 1;\n        Epoch storage ep = _epochs[1];\n        ep.start = uint64(block.timestamp);\n        ep.end = uint64(block.timestamp) + epochDuration_;\n        ep.phase = EpochPhase.Open;\n        emit EpochStarted(1, ep.start, ep.end);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Deposit \u2014 ERC-7984 transfer-and-call callback\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// @notice Called by TOKEN after it moved `amount` (the ACTUAL encrypted\n    ///         amount transferred, post token-side wallet clamp) to this pool.\n    /// @dev    Returns an encrypted verdict: `false` \u21d2 the token refunds the\n    ///         entire transfer atomically. All-or-nothing \u2014 no partial fill,\n    ///         so no amount bit ever leaks through control flow (R2).\n    ///         `operator` and `data` are ignored: credit always goes to `from`.\n    function onConfidentialTransferReceived(\n        address, /* operator */\n        address from,\n        euint64 amount,\n        bytes calldata /* data */\n    ) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused returns (ebool) {\n        if (msg.sender != address(TOKEN)) revert NotToken(msg.sender);\n        // Deposits close at epochEnd even while the phase is still Open \u2014\n        // beginSnapshot may lag, and the participant list/order/count must be\n        // immutable from the freeze point onward (Day 3).\n        Epoch storage ep = _epochs[currentEpochId];\n        if (ep.phase != EpochPhase.Open || block.timestamp >= ep.end) revert WrongPhase();\n\n        Account storage acc = _accounts[from];\n        _registerIfNeeded(acc, from);\n        _checkpoint(from);\n\n        // Lazy zero-init (uninitialized handle \u2260 encrypted zero, CompatSpike pattern).\n        if (!FHE.isInitialized(_totalPrincipal)) {\n            _totalPrincipal = FHE.asEuint64(0);\n        }\n\n        // Wrap-safe cap check via headroom. Invariant principal \u2264 cap holds\n        // after every mutation, so the subtraction can never underflow.\n        // (Deliberately NOT FHESafeMath.tryAdd: its overflow branch returns\n        // sum=0, which a le(sum, cap) comparison would wrongly accept.)\n        euint64 headroom = FHE.sub(FHE.asEuint64(PER_USER_CAP), acc.principal);\n        ebool ok = FHE.le(amount, headroom);\n        euint64 credited = FHE.select(ok, amount, FHE.asEuint64(0));\n\n        acc.principal = FHE.add(acc.principal, credited);\n        FHE.allowThis(acc.principal);\n        FHE.allow(acc.principal, from);\n\n        _totalPrincipal = FHE.add(_totalPrincipal, credited);\n        FHE.allowThis(_totalPrincipal);\n\n        emit Deposited(from, currentEpochId);\n\n        // The token verifies FHE.isAllowed(retval, pot) and then runs\n        // FHE.select(retval, \u2026) itself \u2014 it needs BOTH grants (quirk: dual ACL).\n        FHE.allowThis(ok);\n        FHE.allowTransient(ok, msg.sender);\n        return ok;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Plaintext-gated registration (P-4 revised, user-approved): the gate\n    ///      uses only public facts (caller is the token, pool not full). A\n    ///      deposit later refunded by the encrypted cap check still occupies a\n    ///      slot \u2014 documented in KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md.\n    function _registerIfNeeded(Account storage acc, address from) private {\n        if (acc.registered) return;\n        if (_participants.length >= PARTICIPANT_CAP) revert PoolFull();\n        acc.registered = true;\n        acc.principal = FHE.asEuint64(0);\n        FHE.allowThis(acc.principal);\n        FHE.allow(acc.principal, from);\n        _participants.push(from);\n        emit Registered(from, currentEpochId);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Withdraw \u2014 NEVER gated by pause or phase (non-negotiable #1)\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// @notice Withdraw up to `encryptedAmount`; requests above the balance are\n    ///         clamped to the full balance (no revert \u2014 a revert would leak a\n    ///         comparison between two confidential values).\n    function withdraw(externalEuint64 encryptedAmount, bytes calldata inputProof) external nonReentrant {\n        Account storage acc = _accounts[msg.sender];\n        if (!acc.registered) revert NotRegistered(msg.sender);\n\n        euint64 requested = FHE.fromExternal(encryptedAmount, inputProof);\n        euint64 actual = FHE.min(requested, acc.principal);\n        _debitAndTransfer(acc, actual);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Withdraw the entire principal. Available in EVERY phase, even\n    ///         while paused. Idempotent \u2014 a second call transfers encrypted zero.\n    function withdrawAll() external nonReentrant {\n        Account storage acc = _accounts[msg.sender];\n        if (!acc.registered) revert NotRegistered(msg.sender);\n\n        _debitAndTransfer(acc, acc.principal);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Checks-effects-interactions: principal and total are debited before\n    ///      the external transfer. The transfer's return value is deliberately\n    ///      ignored: the invariant tokenBalance(pot) \u2265 totalPrincipal \u2265\n    ///      principal \u2265 actual guarantees the token-side clamp never fires\n    ///      (proven by the conservation property test).\n    ///      _totalPrincipal is always initialized here: `registered` implies at\n    ///      least one completed deposit callback, which lazily initializes it.\n    function _debitAndTransfer(Account storage acc, euint64 actual) private {\n        _checkpoint(msg.sender);\n\n        acc.principal = FHE.sub(acc.principal, actual);\n        FHE.allowThis(acc.principal);\n        FHE.allow(acc.principal, msg.sender);\n\n        _totalPrincipal = FHE.sub(_totalPrincipal, actual);\n        FHE.allowThis(_totalPrincipal);\n\n        FHE.allowThis(actual);\n        FHE.allow(actual, msg.sender);\n        FHE.allowTransient(actual, address(TOKEN));\n        TOKEN.confidentialTransfer(msg.sender, actual);\n\n        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, currentEpochId);\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Prize funding \u2014 employer money in and out (Day 5, decision (i)).\n    //\n    // The prize arrives as PUBLIC underlying ERC-20 and is wrapped by this\n    // contract in the same tx. That choice is the whole answer to R12: a\n    // confidential transfer clamps a short balance to encrypted zero instead\n    // of reverting, so declaring `prizeAmount += amount` off the back of one\n    // could promise a prize no token backs \u2014 and the winner's claim would eat\n    // another user's principal (non-negotiable #1). An ERC-20 pull reverts.\n    // Allocation therefore IS the funding IS the actual transfer, and\n    // solvency holds by construction rather than by a check we might forget.\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /// @notice Sponsor `amount` confidential units of prize into the current\n    ///         epoch. Two steps for the employer: approve UNDERLYING to this\n    ///         pool, then call this (R13).\n    /// @dev    Gate is `phase == Open`, NOT `!drawn`. The invariant that\n    ///         actually matters is \"this epoch's prize has not yet been\n    ///         committed to a draw or rolled into the carry\", and commitment\n    ///         happens at requestRandom (drawn) OR at the empty-pool\n    ///         fast path (which lands in Settled with drawn still false).\n    ///         Open is the one phase where neither has happened. It also\n    ///         still allows a top-up after epochEnd but before beginSnapshot.\n    function fundPrize(uint64 amount) external onlyEmployer whenNotPaused nonReentrant {\n        if (amount == 0) revert InvalidAmount();\n        Epoch storage ep = _epochs[currentEpochId];\n        if (ep.phase != EpochPhase.Open) revert WrongPhase();\n\n        uint256 underlyingAmount = uint256(amount) * RATE; // exact: no wrap dust\n        SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(UNDERLYING, msg.sender, address(this), underlyingAmount);\n        // forceApprove, not approve: a non-standard ERC-20 reverts when a\n        // non-zero allowance is set over a non-zero one. wrap() consumes the\n        // whole allowance every time, but the pool must not depend on that.\n        SafeERC20.forceApprove(UNDERLYING, address(TOKEN), underlyingAmount);\n        IERC7984ERC20Wrapper(address(TOKEN)).wrap(address(this), underlyingAmount);\n\n        ep.prizeAmount += amount; // checked add \u2014 an overflow here reverts\n        emit PrizeFunded(currentEpochId);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Return up to `amount` of the current epoch's prize to the\n    ///         employer, as confidential tokens. devdoc.details: Non-upgradeable by design. There is intentionally NO function that         moves user principal other than the deposit callback and the two         withdraw functions — "no admin sweep" holds by construction.         Deposit flow (decided Day 1, see COMPATIBILITY_NOTES §3):         user calls token.confidentialTransferAndCall(pot, …) → token moves the         ACTUAL transferred amount (token-side clamp: insufficient wallet balance         becomes encrypted zero, never a revert) → token invokes         onConfidentialTransferReceived on this contract with that actual amount         → we return an encrypted verdict; `false` makes the token refund the         whole transfer atomically (all-or-nothing, no plaintext leak).

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

NothingToClaim().details: Only ever raised on a PUBLIC fact: the caller has never been      scanned by any draw, so no winnings handle exists yet. It never      distinguishes a winner from a loser — both hold an initialized      handle after a scan, and both fall through to the transfer.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

Deposited(address,uint256).details: Emitted on every deposit ATTEMPT — the encrypted cap verdict cannot      be branched on, so a refunded (over-cap) deposit also emits this.

EpochSettled(uint256).details: The epoch is resolved and its prize is final. Emitted for BOTH      terminal paths (scan complete, and the empty-pool fast path), so a      UI has one signal to watch and cannot tell them apart by log shape.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

PrizeClaimed(address,uint256).details: Emitted on every claim ATTEMPT, winner or not — the encrypted      winnings cannot be branched on, and a log that appeared only for      winners would name them outright (§15.1, rule #5).

PrizeFunded(uint256).details: The prize amount is public by design (P-4) but is read through the      prizeAmountOf view, never carried in a log — one uniform event rule      for the whole contract beats a per-event judgement call.

RandomRequested(uint256).details: Draw events carry only public counters — never the randomness, the      ticket, an amount, or (crucially) the winner's address.

SnapshotStarted(uint256,uint32).details: Snapshot events carry only public counters (participant slots,      cursor position) — weights stay encrypted end-to-end.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

beginSnapshot().details: With zero participants the epoch is resolved outright in this         tx: Open → Settled, prize rolled into the carry. Nobody can win         a pool nobody joined, so making a keeper burn 1.75M HCU on a         randEuint64 for it would be pure waste (D9). Emptiness is         public state (participantCount), so this shortcut leaks nothing         — unlike the scan's outcome, which stays encrypted.

claim().details: Deliberately UNIFORM for every caller. A `require(won)` would be         the natural shape and is exactly wrong here: reverting for         losers turns the public revert/success bit into a winner         announcement. Everyone runs the same code, emits the same         event, and moves an encrypted amount that happens to be zero         for all but one of them.         No phase gate either. Winnings accumulate ACROSS epochs (B3         never resets pendingPrize), so "the current epoch is mid-draw"         says nothing about whether last epoch's prize is owed.

defundPrize(uint64).details: Deliberately NOT `whenNotPaused`. This is the D3 escape hatch:         if the owner pauses forever while the epoch sits in Drawing         before requestRandom (KNOWN_LIMITATIONS §7), this is the only         way the sponsored prize gets out — the mirror image of rule #1         for user principal. The employer unwraps on their own time;         unwrap is a 2-tx async dance this pool never enters.         The token-side clamp cannot fire: prizeAmount was backed 1:1 by         a real wrap and nothing else can spend it.

fundPrize(uint64).details: Gate is `phase == Open`, NOT `!drawn`. The invariant that         actually matters is "this epoch's prize has not yet been         committed to a draw or rolled into the carry", and commitment         happens at requestRandom (drawn) OR at the empty-pool         fast path (which lands in Settled with drawn still false).         Open is the one phase where neither has happened. It also         still allows a top-up after epochEnd but before beginSnapshot.

onConfidentialTransferReceived(address,a.details: Returns an encrypted verdict: `false` ⇒ the token refunds the         entire transfer atomically. All-or-nothing — no partial fill,         so no amount bit ever leaks through control flow (R2).         `operator` and `data` are ignored: credit always goes to `from`.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

pendingPrizeOf(address).details: Zero handle (uninitialized) until the user has been scanned in a         draw — UIs must render that as "unavailable", never as 0.

prizeAmountOf(uint256).details: This is not the epoch's payout: a draw pays prizeAmount plus         any carry from earlier winnerless epochs, and that total is         encrypted on purpose (see prizeCipherOf).         It is also NOT zeroed at settlement. Once committed the number         stops being a liability — nothing reads it again, the payout         lives in prizeCipher — and it stays as the public record of         what a sponsor put into a given round (the Day 7 employer         panel's history). Do not read it as "prize still held".

prizeCarry().details: Same policy as totalPrincipal: the handle is public, the ACL is         contract-only, and it is NEVER made publicly decryptable — its         value is a direct statement about past draws' outcomes (#6).         Exposed so conservation can be reasoned about through the ABI;         tests read it with the mock-only debugger.

prizeCipherOf(uint256).details: Handle is public info, ACL is contract-only: nobody decrypts it,         because the gap between this and the public prizeAmount is         exactly the carry, and a non-zero carry means some earlier         epoch had no winner (#6).

renounceOwnership().details: Renouncing while paused would make the pause permanent: nobody      could ever unpause, so `requestRandom` — the one pausable      lifecycle step — would revert forever and the encrypted carry      would be locked with it. User principal still leaves via      withdrawAll either way (rule #1), but that is no reason to leave      a one-tx path to a permanently frozen draw lying around.      Unpause first, then renounce; the end state is identical minus      the trap.

requestRandom().details: The winning ticket is fixed in the SAME tx (P-2 multiply-high):             ticket = ⌊random · totalWeight / 2^64⌋,  random < 2^64         so ticket < totalWeight whenever totalWeight > 0 and the scan is         guaranteed to cross it. No FHE.div/rem anywhere: the euint128         product cannot wrap (both factors < 2^64) and the downcast after         shr(64) is exact (quotient < totalWeight < 2^64).         totalWeight is always initialized here — beginSnapshot is the         only path into Drawing and it writes enc(0) even for an empty pool.

selectBatch(uint32).details: Cumulative-crossing scan (DRAW_PROTOCOL §6.3): the winner is the         first participant whose running weight sum strictly exceeds the         ticket. `selectedAny` gates any later crossing out, so at most         one `hit` is ever true; ticket < totalWeight (P-2) guarantees at         least one when the total is positive. An all-zero-weight epoch         (totalWeight == 0 ⇒ ticket == 0) never crosses — no winner, and         the prize stays with the epoch (§6.4 rollover, resolved Day 5).         Every participant gets the IDENTICAL op sequence — no branch on         encrypted values, no encrypted indexing — so the tx shape         reveals nothing about who won.         The awarded amount is IMMUTABLE from `drawn == true`: whichever         batch crosses the winner must award the same figure. fundPrize         and defundPrize enforce that from the money side (B2), and         since Day 5 it also holds structurally — the amount is the         epoch's prizeCipher handle, frozen once inside requestRandom.

snapshotBatch(uint32).details: A participant's frozen weight is their raw twabArea after         _checkpoint clamps accrual to epochEnd (P-1: no division —         the multiply-high draw is scale-invariant). Participants who         already checkpointed at epochEnd (e.g. withdrew after the         cutoff) hit the zero-elapsed short-circuit: their frozen         weight is untouched, only the total-add runs.

startNewEpoch().details: Requiring Settled — rather than the raw `drawn && cursor ==         count` — is what stops a half-scanned epoch being orphaned with         its prize and its half-written winner flags (B3). It also         covers the empty-pool path, which settles without ever drawing.         Not pausable: pausing stops money coming IN (deposits) and new         draws starting; it must never be able to strand the pool in a         phase it can't leave.         The new epoch starts NOW, not at the old one's end. Backfilling         would hand a long-delayed epoch a window shorter than its own         duration — or none at all. The cost is that the gap between         epochs accrues no weight for anyone (documented in         KNOWN_LIMITATIONS); the benefit is that every epoch is a real,         full-length savings window.

totalPrincipal().details: Returns the zero handle (uninitialized) until the first deposit —         UIs must render that as "unavailable", never as the number 0.

totalWeightOf(uint256).details: Zero handle (uninitialized) until beginSnapshot — UIs must         render that as "unavailable", never as the number 0.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

twabAreaOf(address).details: Returns the zero handle (uninitialized) until the first accrual —         UIs must render that as "unavailable", never as the number 0.

_prizeCarry.details: Prize carried over from epochs that ended with no winner (every      participant's frozen weight was zero, so the ticket scan never      crossed). Whether that happened is ENCRYPTED — publishing it would      reveal that every participant held zero time-weighted balance — so      the rollover has to be encrypted too. Contract-only ACL, never      publicly decryptable (#6).      Handle hygiene: this is only ever assigned the output of an FHE op      (add/select), never a bare FHE.asEuint64(0). Trivial encryptions      alias to one well-known handle (quirk #10), so assigning one in a      winner-dependent branch would leak winner-existence by handle      comparison alone — precisely what the encryption is hiding.

_totalPrincipal.details: Contract-only ACL — never allowed to any user, employer or owner,      never made publicly decryptable. Inspected in tests via the      mock-only debugger, and provable indirectly through conservation.

devdoc.title: PayDayPot — confidential prize-savings pool (PoolTogether-style) on Zama FHEVM

SenderNotAllowedToUseHandle(bytes32,addr.notice: Returned if the sender is not allowed to use the handle.

ZamaProtocolUnsupported().notice: Returned if the Zama protocol is not supported on the current chain

EMPLOYER().notice: Sponsor address funding the prize (no ACL over any user data).

EPOCH_DURATION().notice: Epoch length in seconds (≤ 30 days, enforced by P-3 budget).

PARTICIPANT_CAP().notice: Max participants per pool (≤ 32; keeps snapshot batches bounded).

PER_USER_CAP().notice: Max principal per user (encrypted cap-check on every deposit).

RATE().notice: Underlying units per confidential unit (1 for 6-decimals USDC).

TOKEN().notice: The confidential ERC-7984 token this pool accepts.

UNDERLYING().notice: The public ERC-20 backing TOKEN. Employer funding arrives in         THIS asset and is wrapped inside fundPrize (decision (i)).

beginSnapshot().notice: Move the current epoch from Open to Snapshotting once its end         has passed. Anyone may call — a keeper is a convenience, never         a privilege (rule #7).

claim().notice: Sweep the caller's accumulated winnings to their wallet.         Idempotent: a second call transfers encrypted zero rather than         reverting. Available in every phase, even while paused.

defundPrize(uint64).notice: Return up to `amount` of the current epoch's prize to the         employer, as confidential tokens. Open only while entries are         still open, plus the paused-before-random escape hatch.

drawProgress(uint256).notice: Draw progress for `epochId`: whether randomness is locked, and         the selection scan position ("x/32 scanned", R4).

drawStateOf(uint256).notice: Encrypted draw state for `epochId`: randomness, winning ticket,         running cumulative weight and the selected-any latch. Handles         are public info; the ACL is contract-only — nobody decrypts them.

fundPrize(uint64).notice: Sponsor `amount` confidential units of prize into the current         epoch. Two steps for the employer: approve UNDERLYING to this         pool, then call this (R13).

onConfidentialTransferReceived(address,a.notice: Called by TOKEN after it moved `amount` (the ACTUAL encrypted         amount transferred, post token-side wallet clamp) to this pool.

pendingPrizeOf(address).notice: Encrypted winnings for `user` — decryptable only by the user         themself (the claim flow lands Day 5).

principalOf(address).notice: Encrypted principal handle for `user` — decryptable only by the         user themself (and the contract). Everyone else gets ACL-denied.

prizeAmountOf(uint256).notice: Public sponsored prize funded INTO `epochId` (P-4: the amount         is deliberately public; only user balances/weights are secret).         Immutable once the epoch is drawn.

prizeCarry().notice: Encrypted prize carried over from winnerless epochs.

prizeCipherOf(uint256).notice: Encrypted total pool `epochId`'s draw pays out — its own funded         prize plus any carry. Frozen at requestRandom; zero handle         before that (and for an epoch resolved by the empty-pool path).

requestRandom().notice: Lock the epoch's randomness — exactly once, never rerolled (R5).         Anyone may call; the function takes NO parameters, so a keeper         can trigger the draw but can never supply a seed, a weight or a         winner (rule #7 holds at the signature level).

selectBatch(uint32).notice: Scan up to `maxSteps` participants of the drawn epoch, crediting         the prize to the (single) winner under encryption. Permissionless         and resumable from the stored cursor by any wallet (R4).

snapshotBatch(uint32).notice: Freeze up to `maxSteps` participants' weights at epochEnd and         fold them into the epoch's encrypted total. Permissionless —         any wallet can continue from the stored cursor (R4); a request         past the end of the list is clamped, and the tx that processes         the last participant flips the epoch to Drawing.

snapshotProgress(uint256).notice: Snapshot progress for `epochId`: participants folded into the         total so far, and the frozen list length ("x/32 processed", R4).

startNewEpoch().notice: Open the next epoch once the current one is Settled. Anyone may         call (rule #7) — the pool must never depend on a keeper staying         alive to keep saving.

totalPrincipal().notice: Encrypted global principal accumulator. Handle is public info;         NO ONE holds user-level ACL on it (contract-only).

totalWeightOf(uint256).notice: Encrypted total frozen weight for `epochId`. The handle itself         is public info; the ACL is contract-only — no user, employer or         owner can decrypt it (Day 4's draw consumes it inside FHE ops).

twabAreaOf(address).notice: Encrypted TWAB area for `user` this epoch (Σ principal·dt) —         decryptable only by the user themself. The raw area IS the draw         weight (P-1); average = area / EPOCH_DURATION, client-side.

withdraw(bytes32,bytes).notice: Withdraw up to `encryptedAmount`; requests above the balance are         clamped to the full balance (no revert — a revert would leak a         comparison between two confidential values).

withdrawAll().notice: Withdraw the entire principal. Available in EVERY phase, even         while paused. Idempotent — a second call transfers encrypted zero.

wonOf(address).notice: Encrypted winner flag for `user`. Contract-only ACL (§15.1) —         NO ONE can decrypt it, not even the user; the user-facing reveal         channel is pendingPrizeOf. Zero handle until the user is scanned.

userdoc.notice: Users deposit a confidential ERC-7984 token; principal is always         withdrawable in full (no-loss). Amounts, balances and TWAB live as         encrypted euint64 handles — only the owner of a balance can decrypt it.
